subject: ClearPath discovery: onramp plan, success metrics, and pilot owners
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clearpath.ai>, Tom Ruiz <tom@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery + onramp: ClearPath initial summary and pilot next steps

Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks for a productive call today. Short summary from our side to ensure alignment and make next steps explicit. If I missed anything, please flag.

Key pain points you shared:
- Current invoice summarization pipeline is inconsistent: extraction accuracy varies by vendor and older invoices (OCR noise) drops quality significantly.
- Latency spikes under concurrent user load — mobile UX needs 95th < 350ms.
- Unit costs for the current hosted endpoint are high when scaled to batch processing of monthly invoices.
- Data isolation & auditability are mandatory (PCI-adjacent data; internal audit in Q4).

Primary goals for the pilot (4 weeks):
1) Validate a prompt & eval set that achieves target NER/summary F1 >= 0.88 on your production-like sample.
2) Demonstrate 95th latency <= 300ms for single-shot summarization on a 4-GPU dedicated instance (baseline for UX).
3) Measure tokenized cost per 10k invoices and project monthly run-rate economics.
4) Prove day-1 data controls (access logs, retention policy, KMS integration).

Proposed pilot scope (what we'll deliver):
- Environment: Redwood Dedicated test pool (isolated), with optional Private VPC peering if needed.
- Workload: up to 10k sample invoices across 3 vendors, batch and single-shot paths.
- Deliverables: prompt suite (6 canonical prompts), prompt-eval harness, perf dashboard, short runbook for failover.

Prompt / eval plan (first-pass):
- Prompt groups: invoice header extraction, line-item aggregation, payment terms normalization, vendor normalization, anomaly flagging, human-review shortlist.
- Eval set: 200 labeled invoices (we'll start with 50 you can share + 150 synthetic variants).
- Metrics: F1 (extraction), ROUGE-L for summary consistency, latency p50/p95, and end-to-end cost per 1k invoices.

Owners and roles:
- Customer lead: Samira Khan (ClearPath) — product/acceptance.
- Procurement/contract: Tom Ruiz (ClearPath).
- Redwood PM: Karthik Iyer — engagement lead + SOW owner.
- Redwood Solutions Engineer: Marissa Cole — prompt/eval lead.
- Redwood Security & Access: Steph(anie) Nguyen — security questionnaire & VPC coordination.

Immediate access/setup asks (what we need from you):
1) Share a sample batch (CSV + PDFs) with 50 redacted invoices via SFTP or Drive by EOD Tue 8/24. File naming guidance in the attached spreadsheet.
2) Confirm whether you want VPC peering (preferred) or a secure upload flow. If peering, please loop your infra contact and provide account IDs.
3) Procure a short NDAs/SOW signature path — we'll send a concise SOW and a DocuSign link. Tom — can you confirm procurement timeline?

Attachments: pilot scope workbook (clearpath-pilot-scope.xlsx), SOW draft (sow-draft-clearpath.pdf), security questionnaire (security-questionnaire.xlsx).

Next steps / proposed cadence:
- Kickoff call week of 8/24 — 30–45 minutes to confirm owners, data handoff, and kickoff timeline.
- Week 1: data transfer + baseline eval.
- Week 2–3: prompt tuning & perf runs.
- Week 4: final report, handoff, and closeout.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Samira: confirm sample delivery route (SFTP or Drive) by 8/24.
- Tom: procurement window & PO/contract cadence by 8/26.
- Marissa (Redwood): share initial prompt templates and eval checklist by 8/21.
- Steph (Redwood): security questionnaire completed within 3 business days of sample receipt.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this moving. I will follow up internally with the SOW/DocuSign link once Marissa confirms the prompt set.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.inference.com
(Attachment stubs: clearpath-pilot-scope.xlsx, sow-draft-clearpath.pdf, security-questionnaire.xlsx)

From: Samira Khan <samira@clearpath.ai>

Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom@clearpath.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery + onramp: ClearPath initial summary and pilot next steps

Thanks Karthik — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications / notes from our side: 

- We can deliver the 50 sample invoices via SFTP (I'll send credentials to Marissa directly).
- One additional acceptance metric: end-to-end human review reduction target — reduce manual post-checks by 40% for standard vendors.
- For VPC peering we will require a short security call with our infra team before peering — Tom will coordinate.
- Procurement: Tom — our legal/procurement can sign a short SOW and process a PO within 10 business days once the SOW is final. We prefer a concise SOW and a single-line SLAs appendix.

Let's lock kickoff for Mon 8/24 at 10:00am PT if that works for Redwood.

Samira
VP Product, ClearPath AI
samira@clearpath.ai
